# Borrowing Pilot — Decisions

Only settled choices appear here. See [meeting records](meetings/README.md) for proposals and discussion.

## Decision log

| ID | Date | Decision | Rationale | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D-01 | 2026-09-11 | Keep the posted seven-calendar-day loan period for the pilot. | Reminder timing can be tested separately from the term. | [Kickoff](meetings/2026-09-11-kickoff.md) · [desk notice](sources/README.md) |
| D-02 | 2026-09-22 | Send one optional reminder on day five of a loan, using the reviewed wording. | It leaves time to plan a return without changing the due date. | [Trial review](meetings/2026-09-22-reminder-trial.md) · [message source](sources/reminder-copy.txt) |
| D-03 | 2026-09-29 | Read the written due date aloud at checkout. | Two sample slips were hard to read. | [Slip review](meetings/2026-09-29-slip-clarity.md) |
| D-04 | 2026-10-07 | Retain D-01 and D-02 for the next desk cycle; do not add a second automatic reminder. | 17 of 18 reminded loans returned on time, but the sample is small. | [Pilot review](meetings/2026-10-07-pilot-review.md) · [metrics](kb/pilot-metrics.md) |

## Not decided

A different-branch return procedure and a damaged-tool fee are not in the source notice. They remain [open questions](kb/returns-and-exceptions.md#open-questions), not implied decisions.
